text:
Anya Patel: noticed ~20% more cold-start latency when using the lightweight shard-resolve path (no sidecar manifest). hitting OOMs on <small-gpu> nodes when batch size spikes. any design thoughts?
Chris L: seen same in canary; looks like KV cache warmup isn't applying when we don't prefetch index -> lots of small mmap faults :face_with_rolling_eyes:
Samuel Ng: my take: lightweight path wins on large-shards (single file) but loses on micro-shards due to page-fault storms. we should gate warmstart with a prefetch budget and a mem-safety check
Kai Romero: +1. propose config:
```
warmstart:
  mode: lightweight
  prefetch_budget_bytes: 64MB
  prefetch_parallelism: 2
  mem_safety_threshold: 0.75
```
Anya Patel: nice. how do we enforce mem_safety_threshold across tenants? need global view or per-process?
Chris L: per-node telemetry + reject prefetch when node_committed_memory / total_memory > threshold. infra-bot: added prefetch_budget feature flag to staging :rocket:
infra-bot: deploy 2026-03-20T14:05Z - feature-flag prefetch_budget=true
Samuel Ng: fallback policy: if prefetch denied, switch to index-first streaming for that request and record metric `warmstart.fallback.index_first`
Kai Romero: also consider adding a tiny header to safetensors: `x-prefetch-hint: small_shard=true` so loader can choose strategy without manifest
Anya Patel: hmm header change is invasive for ecosystem. maybe we rely on shard-size heuristic + server-side manifest inference. less breaking.
Chris L: agreed. edge-case: compressed/gzipped shards look small but decompress big -> need uncompressed_size in manifest or sidecar
Samuel Ng: adding uncompressed_size to index or manifest seems ok.
Kai Romero: action items:
- add prefetch_budget feature flag + per-node mem check (Chris)
- implement fallback metric + switch (Samuel)
- prototype heuristic-based lightweight-vs-index decision (Anya)
- add uncompressed_size field proposal for manifest (Kai)
Anya Patel: timeline? can we get a small PR for feature flag this week?
Chris L: I can push PR by Thurs. will include test sim where batch spike triggers fallback. :thumbsup:
Samuel Ng: i'll do metric + dashboard tile next sprint
Kai Romero: will write manifest field RFC next week
Anya Patel: thanks. leaving notes here for postmortem if we iterate.
